card.name: Linking words before adverse-event lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas (including, of, in, and) right before a list or phrase of adverse effects or complications, mostly in anesthetic and obstetric label warnings. Also an opening parenthesis after a function name in code.

modes.label: Links before adverse events
modes.description: A linking word or comma leads into the signs, complications or harms that follow.

modes.label: Code call bracket
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a method name in code, before its arguments.

card.writes: Little clear output effect; it mildly favors code-like opening braces and quote marks.
card.plain: It fires on small joining words just before a list of side effects or complications in warning text.
